abilities.name: Cogbound Alliance
abilities.legend: The Nobles of Questor Mechanicus houses commonly fight alongside the armies of forge worlds. They are bound together by their shared devotion to the Machine Cult.
abilities.description:
Friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models have the following ability:
Assisted Targeting (Aura): While a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is within 6" of this model, that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit’s ranged attacks have:• +1 BS.
• [HEAVY].

Friendly Tech-Priest models have the following ability:
Sacristan Pledge: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model within 3" of this model that has not been selected by this ability this phase. If you do, that model heals D3 wounds.

Mechanicus Allies: You can include Tech-Priest Dominus/Tech-Priest Manipulus/MARSHAL/RANGERS/VANGUARD units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.

abilities.name: Bold Gallantry
abilities.legend: With their companions beside them - kin of their blood, allies in honour - Knightly Nobles are inspired to near-reckless heroism. Their fervour spreads through neural interfaces to reach the machine spirits of their towering Knight suits. The Knights’ power cores flare with motive energy. Target stabilisers sputter into life, glaring balefully at the foe. Servo-motors and fibre bundles thrum, powering the Nobles’ steeds to a thunderous speed, such that the ground trembles.
abilities.description: Each time an Imperial Knights unit from your army Advances, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by IMPERIAL KNIGHTS models from your army have the [ASSAULT] ability.

abilities.name: Dauntless Defenders
abilities.legend: With a rigid, strategic intuition born of the unyielding fortifications defended by their ancestors, the Nobles of a Gate Warden Lance hold their ground with an arrogant superiority. While even one defends the marches of their claimed realm, they will fight to the ends of their honour to hurl back the besiegers.
abilities.description:
At the start of the first battle round, select two objectives to be your foundations. Place a circular 40mm foundation marker in each one. When you draw a line from any part of one your foundation markers to any part of the other, if any part of a model’s base (or any part of a model’s hull, for a model without a base) crosses that line, that model’s unit is said to be on your defensive line.

While an IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit from your army is on your defensive line, that unit has the following ability:

Against the Horde: Each time a model in this unit makes an attack that targets a visible enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll, and weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

abilities.name: Heroes of Legend
abilities.legend: To those who quest for honour - in service to their liege, to avenge atrocities, to wipe clean the stain of disfavour - there can be no end. The Imperium’s foes are legion, an endless horde from which more arise. As one quest ends, another always begins.
abilities.description:
At the start of your turn, if your current Oath is fulfilled, determine an additional Oath as described here, with the exception that you cannot select a Deed or Quality you have already selected (if you are randomly selecting the Deed and/or Quality and roll any result that you have already selected, select a Deed or Quality you have not already selected instead). If you cannot determine an additional Oath because you have already selected each Deed and each Quality, do not determine an additional Oath.

The Qualities from Oaths you have fulfilled continue to apply to all models in your army with the Code Chivalric ability. When the Deed for an additional Oath is completed, you instead gain 1CP, regardless of how you selected the Deed or Quality.

abilities.name: Valour’s Reward
abilities.legend: With every deed sealed with honour, every clarion call heralding a duty met, a champions spirit is strengthened and their ardour restored.
abilities.description: The Enhancements shown below can become expended. You cannot use such Enhancements while they are expended. Each time you fulfil your Oath, each expended Enhancement is no longer expended.

abilities.name: Knightly Teachings
abilities.legend: Knightly Nobles are exalted paragons of honour who uphold the tenets of the Code Chivalric and the glorious histories of their household. Through stern teachings and heroic tales, and no less their own deeds, they exemplify the virtues which Bondsmen aspire to emulate. It is not only in courtly life, upon the practice fields and during thrilling hunts that a Nobles squires and retainers cleave to their duty, but also in the fiery heart of every battle. There such teachings are tested as never before, and also find their most lauded expressions.
abilities.description:
Each time a model from your army uses its Bondsman ability, if no other model from your army has used that Bondsman ability that turn, you can select up to three friendly Armiger models (instead of one) within 12" of that model, or within 15" of that model while your army is Honoured (you still cannot select a model that is already being affected by a Bondsman ability). Until the start of your next Command phase, those models are affected by that Bondsman ability.

KEYWORDS
ARMIGER models from your army gain the BATTLELINE keyword.

abilities.name: Knights of Legend
abilities.legend: Warriors such as these are truly indomitable. Driven on by deadly oaths, bolstered by ancient technology or shimmering with supernatural energies, they stride through the most punishing firestorms to emerge victorious on the other side.
abilities.description: Imperial Knights models from your army have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. In addition, at the start of your Command phase, each IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army regains 1 lost wound.

abilities.name: Rain of Devastation
abilities.legend: Packing together within the confines of cover might work against small arms, but in the face of Dominus-class Knights, it only serves to concentrate and magnify the fury of their firepower.
abilities.description:
Friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS units’ attacks that target a unit
in a terrain area have +1 to hit rolls.

abilities.name: Driven from Their Lairs
abilities.legend: The moment the loyal bondsmen locate and identify the foe, they share targeting data-choristry with their ruling lords and ladies.
abilities.description:
While a friendly ARMIGER unit is affected by a Bondsman ability, that unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].

This detachment has the ARMIGERS tag and cannot be taken with another ARMIGERS detachment.

datasheets.name: Knight Paladin
datasheets.legend: These highly versatile Knights provide strategic backbone to many lances. While not specialised, they are favoured by most houses for their combination rapid-fire battle cannon, a direct firing artillery gun and a powerful close combat weapon. Seasoned Nobles prize these suits.

abilities.name: Code Chivalric
abilities.description:
If your Army Faction is IMPERIAL KNIGHTS, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step, you must determine your army’s Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts - one Deed and one Quality. There are three options for each part, shown below.

To determine your army’s Deed, you can either select one Deed or you can randomly select one Deed by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. The selected Deed will describe what needs to be achieved in order to complete that Deed.

To determine your army’s Quality, you can either select one Quality or you can randomly select one Quality by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.

The first time your selected Deed is completed your Oath is fulfilled and, until the end of the battle, your army becomes Honoured and you gain 2CP, or 3CP if you randomly selected your Deed and/or Quality (CP gained in this way are an exemption to the Core Rules that limit the maximum number of CP you can gain per battle round to 1).

Deed
D6At the start of the battle, select one CHARACTER model in your opponent’s army. This Deed is completed at the end of a turn if that CHARACTER is destroyed.  This deed is completed at the end of your opponent’s turn if you control more objective markers than your opponent.  This deed is completed at the end of the battle round if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than the battle round number even if those units are subsequently returned to the battlefield (for example, two destroyed enemy units in the first battle round).
Quality
D6Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll and you can re-roll one Wound roll.  Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.  Improve this model’s Objective Control characteristic by 2 and its Leadership characteristic by 1.

abilities.name: Super-heavy Walker
abilities.description:
Each time a model with this ability makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so:
• It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them.
• It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after it has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, that model is Battle-shocked.

abilities.description: While a model is affected by this ability, weapons equipped by that model have the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and melee weapons equipped by that model have the [LANCE] ability.

abilities.name: Code Chivalric
abilities.description:
If your Army Faction is IMPERIAL KNIGHTS, at the end of the Read Mission Objectives step, you must determine your army’s Oath for the coming battle. An Oath consists of two parts - one Deed and one Quality. There are three options for each part, shown below.

To determine your army’s Deed, you can either select one Deed or you can randomly select one Deed by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. The selected Deed will describe what needs to be achieved in order to complete that Deed.

To determine your army’s Quality, you can either select one Quality or you can randomly select one Quality by rolling a D6 and consulting the relevant table below. Until the end of the battle, the ability described in the Quality selected applies to all models in your army with this ability.

The first time your selected Deed is completed your Oath is fulfilled and, until the end of the battle, your army becomes Honoured and you gain 2CP, or 3CP if you randomly selected your Deed and/or Quality (CP gained in this way are an exemption to the Core Rules that limit the maximum number of CP you can gain per battle round to 1).

Deed
D6At the start of the battle, select one CHARACTER model in your opponent’s army. This Deed is completed at the end of a turn if that CHARACTER is destroyed.  This deed is completed at the end of your opponent’s turn if you control more objective markers than your opponent.  This deed is completed at the end of the battle round if the number of enemy units destroyed this battle round is greater than the battle round number even if those units are subsequently returned to the battlefield (for example, two destroyed enemy units in the first battle round).
Quality
D6Each time this model is selected to shoot or fight, you can re-roll one Hit roll and you can re-roll one Wound roll.  Add 2" to this model’s Move characteristic and add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for this model.  Improve this model’s Objective Control characteristic by 2 and its Leadership characteristic by 1.

stratagems.legend: With a command, experienced Nobles can lock huge actuators into position, bring reserve power cells into wakefulness and shunt extra shielding into place to make their Knightly steed a bastion of defiance.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is on your defensive line.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greaterthan the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks and is on your defensive line.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greaterthan the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll

stratagems.name: IN THE SHADOW OF GIANTS
stratagems.legend: With the enemy distracted by battling the mighty Knights, the servants of the Omnissiah are free to complete crucial missions unimpeded.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
stratagems.targetText: That ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effectText: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: VENGEANCE OF THE MACHINE CULT
stratagems.legend: Those who dare to fell the Machine God’s creations find themselves subject to the vengeance of the Adeptus Mechanicus.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.

TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle:
• While a unit is marked, friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units’ attacks that target that unit can re-roll wound rolls.
stratagems.whenText: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit.
stratagems.effectText:
That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle:
• While a unit is marked, friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units’ attacks that target that unit can re-roll wound rolls.

stratagems.name: OMNISSIAH’S GRACE
stratagems.legend: So resolute is their faith that the Machine God’s worshippers brave storms of killing fire, trusting in the Omnissiah to shield them from harm.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit suffers a mortal wound.

TARGET: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
stratagems.whenText: Any phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.targetText: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE WARRIOR
stratagems.legend: Death is a distant priority when heroism's favour awaits. A breath to seize a new perspective, a new angle at which to tilt towards the foe, permits only a brief reprieve for the enemy of a true warrior.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase, just after an Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.targetText: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: DRIVEN BY THE PAST
stratagems.legend: To the worthiest Noble, the whispers that reach their mind from a Throne Mechanicum appear as a tapestry of virtues, standards they strive to meet with wholehearted alacrity.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.whenText: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

stratagems.name: COURAGEOUS STAND
stratagems.legend: When the night is long and the unworthy claw at one's shield, it is chivalry and duty that buoy the soul and bolster failing strength.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

stratagems.name: TITANIC DUEL
stratagems.legend: The greatest Knightly champions suffer no dishonourable rival to insult them for long with their existence.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER, TITANIC or WALKER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time your model makes an attack that targets a MONSTER, TITANIC or WALKER unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: MOMENT OF GLORY
stratagems.legend: Veteran pilots waste no more time exalting their victory than the Code Chivalric demands before powering back into the fray with the long strides of the selflessly determined warrior Noble.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, just before an Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army Consolidates.

TARGET: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" provided your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase, just before an Imperial Knights Titanic unit from your army Consolidates.
stratagems.targetText: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" provided your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

stratagems.name: HERO’S TREAD
stratagems.legend: It is said that unalloyed heroism can purge the foulest dishonour, that the very footsteps of those of noblest purity are enough to sanctify their path.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Command phase.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: Your Level of Control over that objective marker is 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.whenText: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.effectText: Your Level of Control over that objective marker is 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

stratagems.name: EXEMPLAR’S WISDOM
stratagems.legend: With a fusillade upon their chosen enemy, the Bondsmen's mentor lectures their loyal servants on the application offeree to the foe's weak points.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army has shot.

TARGET: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model, and one or more friendly Armiger models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, just after an Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army has shot.
stratagems.targetText: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC model, and one or more friendly Armiger models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effectText: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: THIN THEIR RANKS
stratagems.legend: A stentorian firing solution floods their Helms Mechanicum, and eager young Nobles shred their master's foes in a blizzard of fury.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your ARMIGER models have the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability.
stratagems.whenText: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your ARMIGER models have the [RAPID FIRE 1] ability.

stratagems.name: VIRTUE OF COURAGE
stratagems.legend: A Knight must have the courage to face the greatest horrors of the galaxy, with duty focusing their blows.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.
stratagems.whenText: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effectText: Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the phase, each time one of your ARMIGER models makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: LET DUTY BE YOUR SHIELD
stratagems.legend: Heeding the teachings of their Noble master, a Bondsman is reminded that only by enduring can they hope to discharge their sworn obligations.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Armiger unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetText: One Armiger unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking units attacks.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: MANTLE OF THE MENTOR
stratagems.legend: With a rapid volley of covering fire from a Noble liege, Bondsmen employ hit-and-run tactics at high speed.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your ARMIGER models are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back.
stratagems.whenText: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, your ARMIGER models are eligible to shoot in a turn in which they Fell Back.

stratagems.name: SQUIRES OFTHE HUNT
stratagems.legend: At a ritualised signal, Bondsmen encircle the foe to cut off escape, prowling onto unexpected attack routes.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

TARGET: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.

EFFECT: For each of your ARMIGER models that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove that ARMIGER model from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.whenText: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Armiger model from your army, or one Imperial Knights Titanic model from your army, and one or more friendly ARMIGER models affected by that model’s Bondsman ability.
stratagems.effectText: For each of your ARMIGER models that is within 9" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, remove that ARMIGER model from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: HONOURED TO SERVE
stratagems.legend: Determined to prove worthy of a place in battle alongside their supposed betters, bondsmen jump to obey every command issued by their rulers.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ARMIGER unit has shot.

TARGET: That ARMIGER unit.

EFFECT: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ARMIGER unit has shot.
stratagems.targetText: That ARMIGER unit.
stratagems.effectText: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.name: NEURAL LASH
stratagems.legend: Noble pilots have little time for panicked or despairing bondsmen, and think nothing of enforcing stoic obedience by way of stinging neural compulsion.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.

EFFECT: Select one friendly battle-shocked ARMIGER unit within 12" of your unit. That ARMIGER unit is no longer battle-shocked.
stratagems.whenText: Command phase.
stratagems.targetText: One friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS TITANIC unit.
stratagems.effectText: Select one friendly battle-shocked ARMIGER unit within 12" of your unit. That ARMIGER unit is no longer battle-shocked.

stratagems.name: HELM CONDITIONING
stratagems.legend: Some longer‑serving bondsmen become so conditioned to efficient obedience by their Helm Mechanicum that they can be issued neural commands from ever‑greater distances.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit uses a Bondsman ability.

TARGET: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.

EFFECT: When selecting an ARMIGER model for that Bondsman ability, you can select one within 18" of your unit (excluding models already affected by a Bondsman ability).
stratagems.whenText: Your Command phase, when a friendly IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit uses a Bondsman ability.
stratagems.targetText: That IMPERIAL KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effectText: When selecting an ARMIGER model for that Bondsman ability, you can select one within 18" of your unit (excluding models already affected by a Bondsman ability).

stratagems.name: THUNDERSTOMP
stratagems.legend: The Noble brings their Knight suit’s weight down with the force of an industrial piledriver, trampling their honourless foes beneath their iron tread.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights model from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, the Attacks characteristic of any armoured Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 8, the Attacks characteristic of any titanic Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 12, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights model from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, the Attacks characteristic of any armoured Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 8, the Attacks characteristic of any titanic Feet melee weapons equipped by your model is 12, and improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of those weapons by 1.

stratagems.name: FULL TILT
stratagems.legend: With their fellows' oaths ringing through the vox-net and the rush of battle coursing through their veins, Noble pilots pour power into their steeds' motive actuators and thunder onwards.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of your models and add 2 to Advance rolls made for those model’s units.
stratagems.whenText: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, add 2" to the Move characteristic of your models and add 2 to Advance rolls made for those model’s units.

stratagems.name: TACTICAL FOIL
stratagems.legend: The neural bond through their Throne Mechanicum enables seasoned pilots to accomplish swift counter-monoeuvres seemingly impossible for such towering war engines.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights model from your army that is within 8" of that unit.

EFFECT: Your model can make a Normal move of up to D6".
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights model from your army that is within 8" of that unit.
stratagems.effectText: Your model can make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: VOW OF RETRIBUTION
stratagems.legend: With the swearing of cooperative pacts, Knightly companions vow to visit annihilation on their enemies in a searing barrage of retributive firepower.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your models have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
stratagems.whenText: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by your models have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: RUN THEM THROUGH!
stratagems.legend: With deafening challenges blaring from their emitters, honour-bound comrades slam into their foes, where the Nobles' martial prowess and their Knight suits’ overwhelming power are wedded to overcome the most monstrous resilience.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by your models have the [LANCE] ability.
stratagems.whenText: Fight phase.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by your models have the [LANCE] ability.

stratagems.name: ROTATE ION SHIELDS
stratagems.legend: Veteran Knight pilots can swiftly re-angle their ion shields and manipulate their energies to deflect incoming firepower.
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.whenText: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.targetText: One Imperial Knights unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effectText: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Acquisitor-at-Arms
enhancements.legend: This stern Noble serves their household by seizing territories and domains deemed the property of their lord. They are a grim and fearsome agent who inspires their charges with an unwillingness to relent.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While the bearer is on your defensive line and there are no enemy units on your defensive line, add the bearers Objective Control characteristic to that of each model affected by the bearers Bondsman ability.

enhancements.name: Gyro-Optimised Actuators
enhancements.legend: Flowing down the neural tether between Thrones and Helms Mechanicum, the faint whispering of ancestral gheists drives bondsmen on to greater urgency.
enhancements.description: ARMIGER unit only. This unit has MOBILE.

enhancements.name: Bearer of the Iron Chalice
enhancements.legend: Deep within the Knight’s chassis is an ancient STC artefact. The device communes with its weakened machine spirit kin, bolstering their resolve to endure.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Movement phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That selected model regains up to D3 lost wounds, or up to 3 lost wounds if your army is Honoured.

enhancements.name: Magos Questoris
enhancements.legend: An expert in the intricate mechanisms and weapons systems of Imperial Knights, this Tech‑Priest taught Sacristans their craft. They now walk in the shadow of these war machines and make field repairs in the midst of battle.
enhancements.description: TECH-PRIEST model only. When using this model’s Sacristan Pledge ability, the selected IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model heals 2 additional wounds.

enhancements.name: Bringer of Justice
enhancements.legend: It is said that whenever this famed weapon is brought to life, it shall not fall silent until it has slaked its thirst for justice.
enhancements.description: Imperial Knights model only. Improve the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 2, and each time the bearer makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Mentor’s Pride
enhancements.legend: A draconian enforcer of stringent standards, when this stern Noble does acknowledge pride in their servants, their Bondsmen zealously strive to retain it.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more Armiger models are under the effects of the bearers Bondsman ability, each time each of those ARMIGER models makes an attack, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Blessed Plate
enhancements.legend: Some of this Knight’s hull plates are revered antiques, dating back millennia; their durability is a testament to the secrets of construction now lost to the mists of time.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS model only. This model has +1 T.

enhancements.name: Herald of Triumph
enhancements.legend: This Noble’s arrogant challenges herald a feat of victory, a promise of death that blares from their suit’s emitters.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer ends a Charge move, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.

enhancements.name: Knight of the Opus Machina (Aura)
enhancements.legend: A devotee of the Omnissian creed, this Noble is inspired by the presence of the Adeptus Mechanicus, fighting with greater zeal and vigour in their holy presence.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While a friendly ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit is within 6" of this model, that ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit’s melee attacks have +1 WS and AP.

enhancements.name: Archeotech Autoloaders
enhancements.legend: These ancient and precious components are installed with great reverence; their function is to keep the Dominus‑class Knight’s guns firing with ferocious efficiency
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS DOMINUS model only. This unit can re-roll rolls to determine the A of a weapon.

enhancements.name: Bearer of the Evanescent Ion
enhancements.legend: This Knight’s ion shield projects a stream of nictitating particles that can obscure fellow Nobles from sight.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the end of your Movement phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the start of your next Movement phase, that selected model has the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Fables of Nightmare
enhancements.legend: Many are the fiends and unnamed dooms that lead hosts of darkness in the oldest tales. Their retelling spurs this Noble’s Bondsmen to seek out the lurking commanders of the foe and cut them down, so that they may end the spread of their evil.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more Armiger models are under the effects of the bearer’s Bondsman ability, melee weapons equipped by those ARMIGER models have the [precision] ability.

enhancements.name: Hunter’s Eye
enhancements.legend: This remarkable data‑manifold surrounds a scion with holo‑projected bioscans and engine‑signature readouts, whose gaze penetrates the densest terrain as though it was not there.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: Purgation’s Hand
enhancements.legend: The Noble dubbed with this honourable title has sworn to purge the frontiers of their realm, scouring it clean of the stain of everything foul and inimical to the Code.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, if the bearer is on your defensive line, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Wyrmslayer Divination
enhancements.legend: Whispered to a Knights machine spirit before battle, this techno-omen prophesies doom for airborne foes.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. In your Shooting phase, when the bearer is selected to shoot, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then until the end of the phase, each time it makes an attack that targets a unit that can FLY, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Ancestral Overbleed
enhancements.legend: Though it requires additional work by the Sacristans, when Armigers are to be used like hunting hounds amidst dense terrain, it is considered worthwhile to enhance their steeds’ agility.
enhancements.description: ARMIGER unit only. When you target this unit with the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

enhancements.name: Tales of Heroism
enhancements.legend: Recounting the valorous feats of legendary Nobles, this champion inspires their squires to deride and denounce the foes every attempt at evading a just execution.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more Armiger models are under the effects of the bearer’s Bondsman ability, each time one of those ARMIGER models makes a melee attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll and/or the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Augury Halo
enhancements.legend: This web of neuro-couplings has been worked into a richly ornamented helmet. Through it, the Noble pilot can access nearby hidden augur nodes deployed by servitor clades of the Sacristans, inloading targeting data to pick out the locations of shrouded besiegers.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack, while the bearer is on your defensive line, weapons equipped by the bearer have the [ignores cover] ability.

enhancements.name: Bearer of the Judicant’s Helm
enhancements.legend: A courtly counsellor against deception and a visionary hunter of lurking prey, this Noble’s sage advice unmasks the contemptible before their companions.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by that selected model have the [ignores cover] ability.

enhancements.name: Mysterious Guardian
enhancements.legend: Manifesting as though from nowhere, this Knight is an elemental force of vengeance against the Emperor of Mankind’s foes. At battle’s end, it disappears as mysteriously as it arrived.
enhancements.description:
IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is unengaged, you can use this ability. If you do:
• Place this unit in strategic reserves.
• This unit has Deep Strike until the start of your next Shooting phase.
• This unit must make an ingress move in your next Movement phase (including in your first turn).

enhancements.name: Pennant of Silvered Fury
enhancements.legend: This circuit-etched pennant marks a slayer of hordes and is linked to a glowing electoo beneath the pilot’s skin.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer is selected to fight, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [sustained hits 2] ability.

enhancements.name: Crushing Condemnation
enhancements.legend: With the sweep of an armoured limb, the Noble can cast wreckage and ruin towards yet another foe.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. When the bearer is selected to fight, after resolving its attacks, if one or more enemy units were destroyed by those attacks, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, this Enhancement is expended, then select one enemy unit that is not within Engagement Range of any units from your army and is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.name: Vengeful Tread
enhancements.legend: The punitive anger of this pilot towards those who dare defile their realm is terrifying to behold. War horns blaring, they barge and trample forward, crushing their lessers in a terminal lesson of humility.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. Once per turn, you can target the bearer with the Crushing Impact Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Bearer of the Lancer’s Sigil
enhancements.legend: Honoured with a vivid heraldic insignia, this Noble is a wise mentor in the deadly art of battlefield intercession.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. At the start of your Charge phase, select one other IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model from your army that is within 12" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that selected model.

enhancements.name: Martial Tuition
enhancements.legend: Long has this Noble trained their Bondsmen in hunting the deadliest prey, instilling in them the skills to honourably exploit any opening in an enemy’s defence.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. While two or more Armiger models arc under the effects of the bearer’s Bondsman ability, once per turn, you can target one of those ARMIGER models with the Counter-offensive Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Sanctuary
enhancements.legend: Through the projection of rapidly modulating ion fields, this unique generator’s effects wreathe the suit in an all encompassing fog of protective energies that defend it from close‑quarters attacks.
enhancements.description: IMPERIAL KNIGHTS model only. The bearer has a 5+ invulnerable save.
